objective: Define a deterministic operator-first call bridge lifecycle for Telnyx without introducing webhook transport, runtime secrets, production calls, or D1 mutation.
rules: The lead leg cannot be requested before the operator leg has answered.
The bridge cannot be requested before both legs have answered.
External Telnyx call-control identifiers never replace the canonical attempt identity.
Duplicate lifecycle evidence may be handled as an idempotent no-op by later reconciliation.
The domain contains no fetch, Cloudflare runtime access, secrets, or D1 access.
next: INS-002E2B will normalize verified Telnyx voice events into this bridge domain and durable provider-event reconciliation.
